authorization: User requested full profiling/comparison, theoretical exploration first, implementation of all promising options before independent review.
campaign: Full SK algorithm audit after accepted Phase 1
initial_scope: Diagnostic/prototype code and report in this evidence directory; preserve accepted production changes. Select any production adoption explicitly from measured evidence within this approved campaign, recording each logical change.
procedure: Parent theory + additional Sol High mathematical review, Luna High prototype implementation, fresh independent Luna High acceptance review, fresh short Sol High review. No reviews of unfinished prototypes.
resources: One numerical thread, at most two compiler jobs overall, bounded runtime/point/frequency cases; no high-degree angular repair, physical convergence sweep, receiver repair, commit or push.
native_frequency_cases: 1, 3, 12 and up to 48 explicitly recorded raw bins; extended bins are performance/discrete-equivalence probes, not converged physical predictions.
grids: native SEM nodes with separate element-side traces
permuted or sparse points for fallback
timing: Native uninstrumented times, first and warm separated, three independent processes for headline cases, alternating candidate/reference order, identical compiler/thread setup; setup, output and reusable-plan costs separately recorded.

acceptance.numerical_tolerances: Retain prior phase limits and exact normalizations. Changed reduction order may change roundoff, never thresholds.
acceptance.kernels: relative L2 1e-12, scaled pointwise 1e-10 with 0.01*peak floor
acceptance.yspec: Existing informative weighted profile/integral 1e-3; report receiver limitation separately.
acceptance.promotion: Only correctness-passing benchmarked paths; evidence states whether prototype, optional backend or production default. Preserve general sampling and source-contact behavior.

protected: before.json records all tracked file hashes and existing Phase 0 evidence. Sources/ in chat mirror read-only.
